title: oxypetalum insigne
intro: Oxypetalum insigne, commonly known as "Moonflower", is a species of flowering plant in the dogbane family. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Brazil, to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Oxypetalum insigne include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of sedation and anxiolysis.
